_: Baselines and severities for scripts/verify-editorial.mjs. Hand-edited; the checker never rewrites it. EDITORIAL.md is the specification, this file is the state the ratchets run against.

severity._: One entry per Part A rule, visible and diffable, never inferred at runtime. EDITORIAL.md's exit contract points here. HARD blocks the push; ADVISE prints under the ADVISORY heading and does not; DISABLED prints nothing at all. --advisory-only overrides everything to ADVISE for the D16 burn-in.

severity_notes.A12: ADVISE until the D7 mapping is signed off. It cannot be hard while the fix requires a mapping nobody has approved.
severity_notes.A15: ADVISE until data-nochip lands. Hard today would fire on 23 keys that have no way to declare their reason yet.
severity_notes.A17: DISABLED - the vocabulary feature is not built.
severity_notes.A18: DISABLED - the vocabulary feature is not built.
severity_notes.A19: DISABLED - the vocabulary feature is not built.

authoredProse.note: Source notes (R8) and reading blocks (R9) are IN; footer entries (R7) are OUT. EDITORIAL.md's literal phrase 'R1 with R2-R11 removed' would also drop R8 and R9 and does not reproduce the declared A8 table. This definition does. Used by A8 and A9.

quotationScope.note: Deliberately wider than authoredProse. A quotation guard has to reach footer entries and script literals, so A10 does not share A8's population.

A8._: Majority form and minority count over authoredProse. The majority form may not change and the minority count may not rise. Unaffected by the console-fence decision: all four disputed dashes are entities in files whose majority is already entity.

A9._: Total em dashes over authoredProse. May fall, may not rise. This is how D1 is enforced without needing history. session-0.1 and session-1 are the two files the console-fence decision moved: 7 not 11, and 83 not 87 on the entity count.

R11._: The corpus-level baseline for byte-shared boilerplate, so it is checked once rather than nowhere. Measured from the canonical copy: R11 spans deduplicated by SHA-256 of their content, so a block shared across four lessons counts once. Not in conflict with the pre-push md5 pairing, which asserts identity ACROSS files; this asserts stability OVER TIME.
R11.population: mask(R11), deduplicated by content hash across all five lessons
